text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst Keith Westhead started coverage on Tuesday of Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy with a rating of hold.

-- "The development of the Asgard field and the expected sale of its Borealis petrochemicals stake should improve returns for Neste in upstream and chemicals, areas where it has historically underperformed its rivals," Westhead wrote in an analysis.
-- "However, Neste lacks the upstream exposure and international diversification of the European majors, and has by far the highest level of historical earnings volatility.
-- "The substantial trading losses recorded in 1996 and the decision to cut the 1996 final dividend by 18 percent are a further cause for concern.
-- "Neste is trading at similar P/E multiples to (Spain's) Repsol and similar cash flow multiples to (Italy's) ENI.
-- Neste closed at 131 markka on Tuesday.
